title: Morphisms out of a constructible sheaf into a filtered colimit factor through a stage (ring of integers)
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ in which $\ell$ is invertible [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $\Lambda=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ the condensed ring of its integers [def-sfb-padic-integers-condensed-ring]. Let $X$ be a $k$-scheme whose structure morphism $a_X\colon X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type, let $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ be the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ the abelian category of $\Lambda_X$-module objects in abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Call $M\in\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ constructible as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible] (there is a finite stratification of $X$ on whose strata $M$ is pro-étale locally finitely presented), and ind-constructible if it is a filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of constructible objects. Then for every constructible $M$, every filtered diagram $(B_i)_{i\in I}$ in $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ with colimit $B$ and every $n\in\mathbf Z$, every morphism $M\to B[-n]$ in the derived category $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] (objects placed in degrees $0$ and $n$) factors as $M\to B_i[-n]\to B[-n]$ for some $i\in I$, the second map induced by the colimit injection.
